occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: Several paint cans were observed inside of a play house on the outdoor play area..
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based: Six of the seven caregiver files reviewed contained online CPR training with no additional hands-on training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))

occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Supplies Not Expired (26 TAC §746.4003(b))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records Maintained: Five out of 10 children records reviewed didnot have a health statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records Maintained (26 TAC §746.603(a))

occurrences.finding: Using, Storing and Disposing of Hazardous Materials: Bleach and fabulosa were observed to be stored in a low cabinet that was accessible to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Using, Storing and Disposing of Hazardous Materials (26 TAC §746.3407(13))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: Four out of seven staff files reviewed did not contain a pre-employment affidavit. occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Review list and Remove unsafe products: A baby rocker that has has been recalled since August 2022 was observed to be in the infant room.

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Discard Single-Service Items: Several unlabeled disposable juice bottles were observed in a bucket in the freezer. According to the caregiver, they are used to serve water to the children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Discard Single-Service Items (26 TAC §746.3317(4))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: There was a vape cartridge and cigarette box located immediately outside the fence area that leads to the playground. Several paint cans were observed inside of a play house.

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: Seven of seven staff files reviewed did not have current training in the following topics:    (1)Emergency preparedness.    (2)Preventing and controlling the spread of communicable diseases, including immunizations     (3)Administering medication.    (4)Preventing and responding to emergencies due to food or an allergic reaction     (5)Understanding building and physical premises safety, including identification and protection from hazards that can cause bodily injury such as electrical hazards, bodies of water, and vehicular traffic     (6)Handling, storing, and disposing of hazardous materials
